name: Sentinel Bio
summary: A Washington DC grantmaker and research organisation, founded in 2024, that pools philanthropists' money to prevent catastrophic pandemics: grants for DNA synthesis screening and customer checks, governance of AI tools that can design biology, and pandemic preparedness, and advice to other donors on where to give.

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11C.zip (Form 990 for calendar 2024, object 202532799349300228, Part IX line 25 (B): programme services $1,383,548 of total expenses $1,534,257)

lines.label: Grants and Sentinel Bio's own grantmaking work (its one programme)
lines.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11C.zip (Form 990 for 2024, Part III line 4a: one programme in three areas, AI-enabled biology, nucleic acid governance and general programmes, expenses $1,383,548 including grants $1,105,558). One line because charityevals models the grants and its own work as branches of one catastrophic-risk model.
